_comment: HSB live-release manifest. Lists features that are LIVE/known-good and must not be silently reverted by a deploy or apex/www alias move. Read-only guardrail consumed by scripts/predeploy-live-feature-check.mjs: each required feature must be present as a commit ancestor of HEAD (either its requiredCommit or any listed superseding commit). Markers are git commit SHAs. See docs/runbooks/release-hygiene.md.

requiredLiveFeatures.name: voice flag tolerance / voice upload section
requiredLiveFeatures.description: Checkout voice-upload section + tolerant NEXT_PUBLIC_HSB_VOICE_BETA flag parsing (escaped-newline drift). 36c61c3 re-implements/superseding 3ae3380.

requiredLiveFeatures.name: analytics attribution
requiredLiveFeatures.description: Vercel analytics attribution hotfix originally on hsb/analytics-attribution-20260602. MUST be back-merged into the deploy train; its omission is the drift this guardrail exists to catch. 0d8b92c is the PR #38 squash merge onto the deploy train.

requiredLiveFeatures.description: Default-closed owner-test checkout gate + G5 production env checker (PR #34). ca7d860 is the PR #34 merge commit.
